newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - fuel oil down $2, gas oil firms.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel oil down $2, gas oil firms.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Tuesday, gas oil rising in line with futures while fuel oil steadily weakened, dealers said.

High sulphur fuel oil traded from $86 down to $84 fob Rotterdam with supplies appearing healthy. Mid-morning offers were at $84.50 for lower quality RMG and $85.50 for Rotterdam running refinery material.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne firmer as IPE July gas oil futures opened firmer. Prompt remained valued at around July screen flat with little renewed buying interest.
